objectives.name: Slay the Nameless King, Phantasmal Night.

title: Shardbearer: Nameless King
description:
The Nameless King is believed to be hiding atop his throne of skulls in the Netherrealm. Sitting, and biding his time to strike against Umbrocron himself, but out of a desire to prove his quality rather than for good.

[TRANSLATED BY THARNOK] 
???: "- Year 3482, Foundation Era; The king's mining operations have been been met with success, and yet devastating failure. He's dug up all of the mythril in a 500 league radius around the main terminal, and yet he still wants more. He's even sending out task forces stripping civilians of their mythril, and providing miniscule amounts of ventar in return. These deranged priests still insist this is the beginning of the end, and that our punishment will befall this entire world. How ridiculous, I don't have time for these preaching fools."
"- Year 3489, Foundation Era; The king is missing. We have not a clue where he went, the cameras show him entering the archives but he has not returned from them, and he's not inside them either. All the team has found was a book found on the floor titled "Valem The Judge" with nothing written in it. The main terminal building is losing power, it seems like the moons and weakened as well. We cannot continue."

"[WIP DIALOGUE BETWEEN NAMELESS KING AND UMBROCRON/VALEM]"

- Namless King, The Phantasmal Night
